reviews.title: If I can give a 0 stars I will
reviews.text:
Facebook has completely disappointed me. My account has been suspended for 180 days simply because I refused to submit my private identification document and record a video of my face to prove my identity.

This is absolutely unacceptable. I should not have to feel forced to hand over highly sensitive personal information and biometric data just to continue using a social media platform. My identity documents and my face are private, and I have serious concerns about how this information is collected, stored, protected, and used.

What makes this situation even worse is that Facebook gives users little choice and leaves them facing a lengthy suspension if they are uncomfortable sharing such personal information. Six months without access to my account is an outrageous penalty for protecting my own privacy.

Facebook should respect users’ privacy, provide reasonable alternative verification methods, and offer a fair appeal process instead of effectively forcing people to surrender sensitive personal data.

A company with billions of users should be able to treat people with respect, transparency, and fairness. Instead, this experience has destroyed my trust in Facebook.

I strongly discourage anyone who values their privacy from blindly trusting this platform. Users deserve better than threats of a 180-day suspension for refusing to provide private identification and facial video.

Shame on Facebook for putting users in this position. Respect our privacy and give people a choi

reviews.title: Meta AI Needs Improvement
reviews.text:
I really like the Meta glasses themselves. The camera, audio, and hands-free concept are great. My frustration is specifically with Meta AI.

The biggest issue is messaging. Meta AI sometimes sends messages before I finish speaking, and dictated messages often come out in lowercase with poor or missing punctuation. Even after asking it to capitalize sentences and use punctuation, the problem continues. At times, saying “add a period” results in the word “period” being typed instead.

I’ve also asked Meta AI to compose a simple message and been told it can’t do that yet, which feels like a major limitation for an AI-powered wearable. Longer conversations can also end with error messages after only a few exchanges.

What makes this more frustrating is that Siri handles basic dictation, capitalization, and punctuation more reliably.

The glasses have a lot of potential, but Meta AI needs improvement in speech detection, message composition, punctuation, conversation reliability, and remembering user preferences. The hardware is good — the AI is currently the weakest part of the experience.

reviews.title: Used to be great, now it’s a complete waste.
reviews.text:
I’ve used Meta AI for over a year, and it’s gotten progressively worse since the April 2026 update to Muse Spark. What used to be a quick helper is now virtually unusable.
Every time I ask it to do something basic — edit a photo, make a nighttime version, animate a simple walk cycle — it fails. Not once, not twice, but every single attempt. It spins, errors out, and then gives me a paragraph about trying again. Nothing actually gets done.
It doesn't listen, either. I told it no recaps, and it kept recapping. I told it no excuses, and it kept explaining. It's like talking to a wall that also wastes your battery.
The app is now nothing more than a complete waste of time and storage space. It promises image and video tools, but none of them work reliably. If you want an assistant that actually completes the task you ask for, this isn't it anymore. Delete it and free up the space — you'll get the same result, faster.

reviews.title: Existing Account Login Process Needs Major Improvement
reviews.text:
The Meta AI iPad app appears to have been released before basic functionality and usability testing were completed.

I already have an existing Meta account through the Meta View app on my iPhone, using the same Apple account, yet logging into the Meta AI iPad app was anything but simple. It should be a seamless experience for existing users, especially when both devices are tied to the same Apple account. Instead, I was met with a confusing login process that did not recognize my existing setup.

The app expects a password, but there is no clear or obvious path for existing users who may not have created a separate password during their original setup. There is also no readily apparent account recovery or password reset option within the app, leaving users stuck trying to gain access to an account they already use elsewhere.

The birthday verification process is equally frustrating. The calendar interface is poorly designed. Once a month is selected, the app jumps to the next field, forcing users to repeatedly reopen the calendar to make corrections. Because the date defaults to the current date, changing the year requires excessive scrolling and multiple unnecessary steps.

These are basic user experience issues that should have been identified and resolved before release. Existing customers should not struggle to log into an app associated with an account they already use, and simple tasks like entering a birth date should not be this cumbersome.

As it stands, the app fee

reviews.title: Meta’s racist ad
reviews.text:
An ad for this Meta AI app showed up in my feed with an immediate powerful lesson about these tools- and it’s not a good one. It served up 1 image on the left- a Black man shouting, surrounded by police officers, with a heavy chain around his neck. On the right was an Aryan fantasy- a white man and woman walking through a gold palace in elegant, almost royal clothing.

Side like this, the contrast feels deeply uncomfortable. Themes of chaos and criminality are juxtaposed with wealth and power, lined up in racial lines in an obvious way. This echoes and perpetuates a long and painful history of bias.

Maybe this pairing was generated automatically. Maybe no one looked closely before it was pushed out as an ad. But that is exactly the problem. This imagery carries cultural weight, and someone should be paying attention. Meta should be ashamed by the story their ad is telling.

reviews.title: Required for Ray Bans, but not great
reviews.text: I'm not a fan of AI. But I liked the idea of having a camera in my glasses to easily capture memories with my family. This app is required to use Meta Ray Bans, which makes sense, they are marketed as AI assistants in your glasses. But the app is so AI-forward, it can be annoying to navigate. It would be great to have the option to set "Devices" as the main page that opens up when I open the app, so I don't have to deal with "Vibes" and "AI Chat" if I don't want to. I know it's just a couple of clicks but seriously, why do I have to use the AI app just to transfer photos and videos from my glasses to my phone? Just make a separate app or give me options to disable the AI stuff in this app.

reviews.title: Stole my work
reviews.text: I worked for hours on a really cool fun project got a bunch of ideas flowing after I started the project and got the ai to actually listen to what I was describing. I only used the app for a few hours then all of a sudden as I’m saving the videos and going back the chat disappears and I all of a sudden don’t have any access to the past work I had access to ten minutes prior the chat history and conversations disappeared and there’s no way to get back. Hours of my life wasted. Now I get why artist don’t like Ai if i spent hours on a project and drew it by hand designed and edited the video myself. It may have taken years to do it may of come out wrong but I wouldn’t have gotten scammed out of my idea or creations. Artists like real artist that care about what they are creating and not just making some lame ten second video you are better off just drawing it out yourself and creating your own animations or loops using a different program that is more secure and transparent.

reviews.title: Violation of privacy
reviews.text: I downloaded the app when prompted on social media. I didn’t use the Meta App, but I connected it to my social media account. I use a VPN on my phone and computer. I will not allow my privacy to be violated so I decline giving access to my federally protected personal private information. I received an email stating “Your Meta account has been suspended. We did this because your account, or activity on it, doesn't follow our Terms of Service.” because I will not give Meta Ai access to my camera, microphone or other data. When I went to challenge this decision I was told I needed to give access to my camera and undergo a live recorded screening to verify my identity on camera and that I am an actual person. I will not allow my federally protected rights to be violated.

reviews.title: FIX VOLUME CONTROL
reviews.text:
The volume keeps adjusting to MAX volume — even with turning auto adjust off! Please make a way to control the volume with your voice and keep it volume until you decide to turn it up.
I will say, “Hey Meta,  put the volume at one percent. “ and it will go right back to 100%. this is frustrating and embarrassing in public. I use the touchpad to turn it back down and it goes right back to 100%. I use my voice, I go into the app, I actually use the  plume control buttons on the phone and it continues to go straight back to 100% no matter what I do. The price you pay for these glasses should have an option to control the volume permanently until you decide to change it. About a month ago, I put in a help request to suggest this be enabled. I see it still hasn’t been done.
